transcript: Can I make 50,000 Rupees using Raj Shamani's business idea? Let's find out on Episode 1 of UN-BROKE-ING INDIA. Step 1. Tum Google pe jaao. Find out and list down everybody jo high value client hai and unki website nahi hai wahan pe. So I made a list of all the doctors near me who don't have a website. Step 2. And go to ChatGPT. ChatGPT tumhe बढ़िया sa wo utha ke Emergent pe daalo. Tumhare saamne website aa jaayegi bahut hi jaldi. So I selected 1 of the doctors. ChatGPT gave me all the details and Emergent gave me the website. It has amazing copy, testimonials section, it also integrated Google Maps and a WhatsApp contact button. But how much money can we actually make from this? Step 3. And wo website jaake us insaan ko bech do. So I started calling all the doctors one by one, but things were not looking good. Nahi chahiye website. Hello? Main na out of station hu 2 din ke liye. But after just 10 calls, THIS happened! Yeah, sure, you can share me the sample. So I sent our website sample as fast as I could. I thought she would ghost me, but in just 24 hours, we made 15,000 Rupees. If you don't believe me, comment "PROOF" and I'll share it with you.
caption:
I tested Raj Shamani’s business idea to make ₹50,000 on Episode 1 of Unbrokeing India. The strategy was simple:

1️⃣ Find local businesses without a website.

2️⃣ Use ChatGPT + Emergent to build one in 5 minutes.

3️⃣ Sell the value.

After a few “No’s,” one “Yes” turned into 15,000 rupees for 5 min
